summary: Sets a per-instance speed value at this+0x3978 from the float argument, then mirrors that value into the global dbl_7C75C4 when the rigid-body constraint pointer at this+0x32BC is null. Returns the (previously read) constraint pointer value.

operations.description: Write the float argument a2 into the local speed field (this+0x3978).
Load the rigid-body constraint pointer (this+0x32BC) into result.
Mirror to the global only when the constraint pointer (this+0x32BC) is null.
Write the float argument a2 into the global dbl_7C75C4.
Return result (the mirror gate value read from this+0x32BC).
